name: Ganymede
pages: Ganymede is found near Jupiter. Look for the largest moon made of cobblestone.$(br2)Natural resources: iron, redstone, ganymedian dust (red lunar dust).$(br)Mobs: Voided, Skeletons, SpaceFellows, Lunar Slimes

pages.text: Ganymede bricks can be used to craft a portal to Ganymede, and then lit using flint & steel.$(br)This does mean you need to visit Ganymede for the first time using the spaceship, or be in creative mode!$(br2)Note: portals can only be used to or from the overworld!
Check out some fun facts about Ganymede, courtesy of NASA!
